skills_boots_blurb: You walk faster. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_bulk_up_blurb: You carry taller stacks. Each rank adds {step} to the pile you can hold, {crafted} for bottled and jarred goods.
skills_bulk_up_skillblurb: You carry up to {stack} of a kind in hand, {crafted} for bottled and jarred goods.
skills_driving_classes_blurb: You drive faster and burn less fuel. Each rank adds {pct}% to top speed and acceleration, and cuts burn {pct}%.
skills_driving_classes_skillblurb: You drive {pct}% faster and burn {pct}% less fuel.
skills_tending_blurb: Empty-handed, tend a growing plant or an off-season tree once. Plants become slightly happier. Ripe plants cannot be tended.
skills_seed_bank_blurb: Seed packs bought from the Seed silo arrive at {pct}% Quality. Without this, bought seed starts at 0% Quality.
skills_seed_bank_skillblurb: Seed packs bought from the Seed silo arrive at {pct}% Quality instead of 0%.
skills_better_potato_blurb: Ripe Potato has higher Quality, and is more likely to ripen as the next Variety, than Potato grown without this skill.
skills_better_wheat_blurb: Ripe Wheat has higher Quality, and is more likely to ripen as the next Variety, than Wheat grown without this skill.
skills_better_tomato_blurb: Ripe Tomato has higher Quality, and is more likely to ripen as the next Variety, than Tomato grown without this skill.
skills_better_raspberry_blurb: Ripe Raspberry has higher Quality, and is more likely to ripen as the next Variety, than Raspberry grown without this skill.
skills_better_grape_blurb: Ripe Grape has higher Quality, and is more likely to ripen as the next Variety, than Grape grown without this skill.
skills_machinery_blurb: Machine work finishes sooner. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_forecast_blurb: Tomorrow's weather appears next to today on the top bar, so you can plan irrigation, the stall, and pump spend before morning.
skills_inherit_land_blurb: A relative signs a plot over to you. Each rank grants one expansion permit. The land still costs money.
skills_saleswoman_blurb: Produce at the stall sells for more. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_saleswoman_skillblurb: Produce at the stall sells for {pct}% more.
skills_heirloom_blurb: You have become a noted quality heirloom producer. Heirloom produce sells for more. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_industrial_blurb: Completed contracts pay more. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_broker_blurb: The Contracts board grows. Each rank adds one offer and one running contract.
skills_broker_skillblurb: The Contracts board grows by {n} offer and you can run {n} more contract.
skills_grafting_blurb: Chop a mature tree and grafts of that tree's Variety drop beside the Wood. Hold a graft against a growing plant or a growing tree of the same crop to turn it into that Variety.
skills_specialty_blurb: Jam, spirits, Wine, and Cider of a Named or Heirloom Variety sell for more. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_specialty_skillblurb: Jam, spirits, Wine, and Cider of a Named or Heirloom Variety sell for {pct}% more.
skills_unknown_blurb: You do not know what this does.
skills_jam_blurb: Fruit below half freshness rots slower. Each rank adds {pct}%.
skills_jam_skillblurb: Fruit below half freshness rots {pct}% slower.
skills_lucky_husband_blurb: A burrow that appears after you learn Lucky holds more money in treasure than a burrow that appeared without Lucky, and more often holds a seed or tree seed of a Variety the Seed silo does not sell as a pack. You, Husband, and Daughter can each learn Lucky, and each one who has raises both. Burrows already on the farm do not change.
skills_lucky_daughter_blurb: A burrow that appears after you learn Lucky holds more money in treasure than a burrow that appeared without Lucky, and more often holds a seed or tree seed of a Variety the Seed silo does not sell as a pack. You, Husband, and Daughter can each learn Lucky, and each one who has raises both. Burrows already on the farm do not change.
skills_lucky_blurb: A burrow that appears after you learn Lucky holds more money in treasure than a burrow that appeared without Lucky, and more often holds a seed or tree seed of a Variety the Seed silo does not sell as a pack. Each rank raises both. Burrows already on the farm do not change.
